decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a sharp, sustained U-component drop near index 610–615 without an obvious return, and (2) a coherent multi-axis linear trend beginning at index 725, suggesting a possible slow offset or ramp. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth motion without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: U-component shows a sharp, multi-sample drop (~−8 MAD to −11 MAD) near index 610–615, with no clear opposing return in the immediate aftermath; N and E components show modest correlated fluctuations but no comparable abrupt shift. The drop appears sustained over several samples and stands out against background noise.

From ~725 onward, all three components (N, E, U) exhibit smooth, coherent linear trends: N rises ~2.5 MAD, E drops ~0.5 MAD, U rises ~1.5 MAD over ~5 samples. This suggests a possible platform-like offset or slow ramp not seen earlier; the coherence across axes and absence of noise spikes make it distinct from typical daily variability.
